inputs.text: [excited] tih… TAN… is. It comes from the Titans, [proud] the all-powerful giants in old Greek stories. The Titan bird.
[happily] A real bird, yes — [serious] but not a dinosaur. It showed up way later, [pauses] three million years ago, in North America.
[confident] With real feathers, yes. [amazed] But way too big and heavy to fly.
